units.source_text: 天色渐暮，兵部卿亲王回进帘内去了。

en.t: As dusk gradually fell, Prince Hyobukyo went back inside the curtains.
Prince Genji could not help feeling intensely envious.

units.source_text: 往昔他受父皇庇护，也可进入帘内，亲近藤壶妃子，直接和她谈话。

en.t: In the past, under his imperial father's protection, he too could enter behind the curtains, draw near to Lady Fujitsubo, and speak with her directly.

units.source_text: 然而现在已经完全疏远，想起了好不伤心！

en.t: But now he had been completely kept at a distance, and the thought of it filled him with sorrow.

units.source_text: 这正是源氏公子的妄想。

en.t: This was precisely Prince Genji's own vain imagining.

units.source_text: 他只得起身告辞，一本正经地对侍女们说：“理应常来请安，因无特别要事，遂致怠慢。

en.t: He had no choice but to rise and take his leave, saying solemnly to the ladies-in-waiting, "I ought to come often to pay my respects, but since there has been no special business, I have allowed myself to be remiss.

units.source_text: 今后若有吩咐，定当随时效劳，不胜荣幸。”

en.t: If there should be any instructions in the future, I would be deeply honored to serve at any time."
After saying this, he went home.

units.source_text: 此次王命妇也无术可施。

en.t: This time, even Omyobu had no means left to help.

units.source_text: 藤壶妃子怀孕已逾半载，心情比以前更加郁结，一直默默无言，闷闷不乐。

en.t: Lady Fujitsubo had been pregnant for more than half a year, and her spirits were even more oppressed than before; she remained silent and deeply melancholy.

units.source_text: 王命妇睹此情景，又觉可耻，又觉可怜。

en.t: Seeing this, Omyobu felt both ashamed and full of pity.

units.source_text: 源氏公子托她办的事毫无进展。

en.t: The matter Prince Genji had entrusted to her made no progress at all.

units.source_text: 源氏公子和藤壶妃子都时时刻刻在心中愁叹：“前世作孽！”

en.t: Prince Genji and Lady Fujitsubo were both constantly grieving in their hearts, thinking, "This must be the sin of a former life!"
For now, let this matter be set aside.
